name: BlockTV
short_description: Customisable Bitcoin dashboard: block height, price, moscow time, fees, halving, zaps and more.
long_description: BlockTV is a clean, customisable Bitcoin dashboard. Compose your own screens from seventeen data fields: block height, spot price in seven currencies, moscow time, halving countdown, median/high/low priority fees, circulating supply, market cap, clock, latest nostr zap, NWC wallet balance, and five price charts from 24 hours up to one full four-year halving cycle. Charts plot real samples only, with per-range staleness warnings and a self-recorded 5-minute 24h series. Swipe or use a keypad between pages, drag fields to reorder them, and pick your own text and background colours.
